name: Default
shortDescription: RetroArch emulator frontend streamed to the browser behind a password, with gamepad support and settings, cores, saves and states kept on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Sign in with the CUSTOM_USER and PASSWORD values from the environment. This basic auth is the only protection, and anyone who signs in gets passwordless sudo inside the container. No games are included: uploads from the web client land in /config/Desktop.
HTTPS is required; the browser desktop does not work over plain HTTP.
